title.narrative: Technical Support to CODEMGE in Structuring Partnerships in the Area of Social Infrastructure and Urban and Regional Development in Brazil

description.narrative: The Minas Gerais Development Company (CODEMGE) has the mission of promoting the social and economic development of the State of Minas Gerais in Brazil. The project aims to strengthen the capacity of CODEMGE to develop private-public partnerships for social infrastructure and urban and regional development, and directly support the development of 5 private-public partnerships.
